aka.zh: 德令哈—马尔康高速公路（德马高速，2022 年前）

tagline.en: Across the Qinghai plateau from the Qaidam basin to the source region of the Yellow River and down into the Tibetan valleys of western Sichuan
tagline.zh: 从柴达木盆地横越青海高原，经黄河源区，下到川西藏区的河谷

start.en: Delingha, Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai
start.zh: 青海省海西蒙古族藏族自治州德令哈市

end.en: Near Maerkang (Barkam), Aba prefecture, Sichuan, at the junction with the Chengdu–Changdu expressway; the 2022 plan extends the route to Kangding
end.zh: 四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康市附近，接 G4217 蓉昌高速；2022 年规划延伸至康定

en: G0615 is a link line of G6, the Beijing–Lhasa expressway. It leaves the Qaidam basin at Delingha, passes Ulan and Dulan, where it shares a stretch of G6, and crosses the high plateau of Qinghai south-east by Xiangride and Huashixia. The 389 km from Huashixia through Maduo, Maqin and Gande to Jiuzhi in Golog prefecture run at an average altitude of about 4,000 m. In Sichuan it descends by Ngawa county, Hongyuan and Shuajingsi to meet the Chengdu–Changdu expressway near Maerkang. The road was planned as the Delingha–Maerkang expressway; the national highway plan of July 2022 extended it by Jinchuan and Danba to Kangding. That extension is still at the planning stage, except for a section from Bamei to Xinduqiao, approved in July 2025 as part of a Luhuo–Xinduqiao expressway.
zh: G0615 是 G6 京藏高速的联络线。它从德令哈离开柴达木盆地，经乌兰、都兰（其间与京藏高速共线一段），向东南经香日德、花石峡横越青海高原。花石峡经玛多、玛沁、甘德至果洛州久治的 389 公里，平均海拔约 4000 米。进入四川后经阿坝县、红原、刷经寺下行，在马尔康附近与蓉昌高速相接。这条路原规划为德令哈至马尔康高速；2022 年 7 月印发的国家公路网规划将其经金川、丹巴延伸至康定。延伸段尚处于规划中，只有八美至新都桥段作为炉霍至康定新都桥高速的一部分，于 2025 年 7 月获得核准。

en: The Qinghai sections were built between 2013 and 2017. Delingha–Xiangride, 176.486 km, was begun in August 2013 and opened on 1 October 2016; Xiangride–Huashixia, 155.19 km, opened on 20 October 2016; and Huashixia–Jiuzhi opened on 13 November 2017.

In Sichuan, work on the 224 km Jiuzhi–Maerkang expressway began on 26 September 2019. About 40% of it is on bridges or in tunnels and it is designed for 80 km/h. It opened in stages: from the Qinghai border to Ngawa on 31 December 2022, 48.5 km from the Wangjiazhai junction with the Chengdu–Changdu expressway at Shuajingsi to Rangkou in 2024, and a further 87.5 km in two pieces, from the Ngawa interchange to the Anqiang service area and from Haizishan to Zhongrangkou, at midnight at the end of 29 December 2025.
zh: 青海境内各段于 2013 年至 2017 年间建成。德令哈至香日德段 176.486 公里，2013 年 8 月开工，2016 年 10 月 1 日通车；香日德至花石峡段 155.19 公里，2016 年 10 月 20 日通车；花石峡至久治段 2017 年 11 月 13 日通车。
四川境内，全长 224 公里的久治至马尔康高速于 2019 年 9 月 26 日开工，桥隧比约 40％，设计时速 80 公里。该路分段通车：青川界至阿坝段 2022 年 12 月 31 日通车，刷经寺（蓉昌高速王家寨枢纽）至壤口段 48.5 公里 2024 年通车，阿坝互通至安羌服务区、海子山停车区至中壤口互通两段共 87.5 公里于 2025 年 12 月 29 日 24 时通车。

en: The magnitude 7.4 earthquake of 22 May 2021 in Maduo county, which the Huashixia–Jiuzhi section crosses, badly damaged parts of the road. The Qinghai transport department listed G0615's Huashixia–Jiuzhi section and G0613's Gonghe–Yushu section as the two damaged expressways, with 227 km of roadbed and pavement, 22 bridges and 4 tunnels affected between them.
zh: 2021 年 5 月 22 日，花久段途经的玛多县发生 7.4 级地震，部分路段严重损毁。青海省交通运输厅通报，G0615 花久段和 G0613 共玉段两条高速公路受损，合计路基路面 227 公里、桥梁 22 座、隧道 4 座。

en: No total has been published. The Qinghai sections cost 3.434 billion yuan for Delingha–Xiangride and 4.573 billion for Xiangride–Huashixia; Huashixia–Jiuzhi was reported in 2013, before construction, at 384.2 km and 20.4 billion yuan. The Sichuan Jiuzhi–Maerkang expressway is estimated at about 28.7 billion yuan, roughly 128 million a kilometre, more than six times the cost per kilometre of Delingha–Xiangride.
zh: 全线没有公布总造价。青海境内，德令哈至香日德段 34.34 亿元，香日德至花石峡段 45.73 亿元；花石峡至久治段在 2013 年开工前报道为 384.2 公里、204 亿元。四川久治至马尔康高速估算约 287 亿元，每公里约 1.28 亿元，是德令哈至香日德段每公里造价的六倍多。

why.en: No total has been published, and the 2022 extension to Kangding is not yet built. Sourced section costs are given below.
why.zh: 没有公布全线总造价，2022 年规划的康定延伸段也尚未建成。下列为有来源的路段造价。

why.en: No funding statement has been found for the Qinghai sections or the Jiuzhi–Maerkang expressway; the only investor named in the sources is the Sichuan Tibetan Area Expressway company, which leads the investment in and construction of the Bamei–Xinduqiao section approved in 2025.
why.zh: 未查到青海各段或久马高速的出资说明；资料中唯一点名的投资方是牵头投资建设八美至新都桥段（2025 年获批）的四川藏区高速公路有限责任公司。

timeline.en: Work on Delingha–Xiangride begins in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，德令哈至香日德段开工。

timeline.en: Delingha–Xiangride opens on 1 October and Xiangride–Huashixia on 20 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日德令哈至香日德段通车，10 月 20 日香日德至花石峡段通车。
11 月 13 日，花石峡至久治段通车。

timeline.en: Work on the Jiuzhi–Maerkang expressway in Sichuan begins on 26 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，四川久马高速开工。

timeline.en: The Maduo earthquake of 22 May damages the Huashixia–Jiuzhi section.
timeline.zh: 5 月 22 日，玛多地震造成花久段受损。

timeline.en: The Qinghai border–Ngawa section opens on 31 December; the July national plan extends the route to Kangding.
timeline.zh: 7 月，国家公路网规划将线路延伸至康定；12 月 31 日，青川界至阿坝段通车。
刷经寺至壤口段 48.5 公里通车。

timeline.en: The Bamei–Xinduqiao section of the extension is approved in July; a further 87.5 km of Jiuzhi–Maerkang opens on 29 December.
timeline.zh: 7 月，延伸段八美至新都桥段获批；12 月 29 日，久马高速又有 87.5 公里通车。
